footer_tagline: Cairn — AGPL-3.0 · self-hosted multi-source activity tracker
overview_intro: Self-hosted multi-source activity tracker. This UI talks to the running Cairn instance via the /admin/* endpoints.
token_missing_hint: Set the environment variable before starting npm run dev:
activities_no_user: No user — create one through the admin API first.
activities_empty: No activities yet. Connect Strava/Garmin or upload a FIT file.
detail_streams_pending: Stream data exists — the frontend is waiting on the ActivityService.GetStream Connect RPC.
admin_intro: Operator console. Mirrors the server's /admin/* HTTP endpoints.
notifications_intro: PR alerts, segment leaderboards, system events.
notifications_pending: This page is waiting on the NotificationService.List RPC. The server already has the use case (see usecase/notification) but the Connect handler isn't mounted yet.
connections_intro: Connect your own provider accounts. Each provider needs your own OAuth app credentials — Cairn never ships shared keys.
connections_error_exchange_failed: Provider rejected the connection. Check your credentials.
gear_intro: Your bikes and shoes. Gear is attached to activities from your connected providers, or by you; totals are computed from your activities.
gear_defaults_intro: Applied once to manual and uploaded activities when they are created. Imported activities take the gear your provider recorded.
gear_empty: No gear yet. Add a bike or a pair of shoes, or sync gear from a connected account.
gear_pending_intro: A provider reported gear Cairn does not know yet. Create it as new gear, or map it onto gear you already have.
gear_sync_hint: Provider gear lists are synced with every reconcile; use “Sync gear” on Connections to fetch them now.
gear_prompt_text: No gear set for this activity.
gear_prompt_dismiss_hint: This activity used no gear — stop asking
gear_confirm_delete: Delete “{name}”? {count} activities keep no gear afterwards.
gear_confirm_merge: Merge “{from}” into “{to}”? Its activities and provider records move over; this cannot be undone.
gear_sync_queued: Gear sync queued — new gear shows up under Gear as the worker reports it.
